dialogue.content: こんにちは。メンタルトレーナーです。本日のテーマは恋愛のメンタルトレーニングです。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a mental trainer. Today's theme is mental training for romantic relationships.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。実は結婚式の1ヶ月前になって、やっぱり私とは結婚できないって、婚約破棄されました
dialogue.English: Hello. Actually, just one month before the wedding, he broke off the engagement, saying he couldn't marry me after all.

dialogue.content: ご相談頂きありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out to talk with me.

dialogue.content: ええ...そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I see... I’m sorry that happened.

dialogue.content: 結婚1か月前となると本当につらいですよね。
dialogue.English: To have that happen a month before your wedding must be incredibly painful.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。もう頭が真っ白になってしまって…
dialogue.English: Yes. My mind just went completely blank...

dialogue.content: うん、うん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm.

dialogue.content: びっくりしますよね。頭が真っ白になるのも無理はないと思います。
dialogue.English: It's shocking, isn't it? It's completely understandable that your mind would go blank.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しく状況を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a bit more about the situation?

dialogue.content: はい。理由を聞いたら、「見た目」だそうです
dialogue.English: Yes. When I asked for the reason, he said it was my "appearance."

dialogue.content: 確かにこの4年間で太ったと思います
dialogue.English: It's true that I’ve gained weight over the past four years.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それで、2週間でダイエットしました
dialogue.English: So I went on a diet for two weeks.

dialogue.content: で、彼に会って話しがしたいと言って1回だけ会いました
dialogue.English: Then, I told him I wanted to meet and talk, and we met just once.

dialogue.content: ダイエットも頑張られたんですね。
dialogue.English: You worked so hard on your diet.

dialogue.content: うんうん。どんな話ができましたか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. What were you able to talk about?

dialogue.content: やせた自分を見たら、気持ちも変わるかなって。
dialogue.English: I thought that if he saw I had lost weight, his feelings might change.

dialogue.content: うんうん。なるほど。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. I see.

dialogue.content: でも、彼の気持ちは変わらないと…
dialogue.English: But he said his feelings wouldn’t change...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。ダイエットも頑張られて、彼の気持ちが変わってほしかったですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. You worked so hard on your diet, and you really wanted his feelings to change, didn't you.

dialogue.content: でもダメでした
dialogue.English: But it was no use.

dialogue.content: なるほど。つらい思いをされましたね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very painful.

dialogue.content: 本当には愛されてなかったのかな…
dialogue.English: I wonder if I was ever truly loved...

dialogue.content: うんうん。そう感じるのも無理はないですよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It's completely understandable that you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: 見た目で結婚出来ないってどういうことですかね。
dialogue.English: What does it even mean to say you can’t marry someone because of their appearance?

dialogue.content: 4年付き合ってきたのに
dialogue.English: Even though we've been together for four years.

dialogue.content: 本当ですよね。納得いかないですよね。
dialogue.English: You're absolutely right. It's hard to accept, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 4年も！
dialogue.English: Four whole years!

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 余計にびっくりですね。
dialogue.English: That makes it all the more shocking.

dialogue.content: 今後どうなっていけば良いとお感じですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel you'd like to move forward from here?

dialogue.content: 彼なりには、その間ダイエットを促していたと言うんです。
dialogue.English: He says that, in his own way, he was encouraging me to diet during that time.

dialogue.content: わからないです
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 悔しいから見返したいけど、まだそこまで気持ちがいかない
dialogue.English: I'm frustrated, so I want to make him regret it, but I'm just not in a place to feel that way yet.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。すぐに気持ちを切り替えるのも難しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's difficult to just change how you feel right away, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。とりあえず裁判をすると親は言っています
dialogue.English: That's right. For now, my parents are saying we should take it to court.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そのことをあなたも望んでいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is that something you want as well?

dialogue.content: 裁判はやろうと自分でも思います。式のお金の問題もあるし。でも、それで気持ちがスッキリするかどうか…
dialogue.English: I think I will go through with the lawsuit. There’s the issue of the wedding expenses, too. But I’m not sure if that will make me feel any better...

dialogue.content: うん、うん。なるほど。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm. I see.

dialogue.content: では、あなたは裁判で今回のことを
dialogue.English: So, with the lawsuit, you want to

dialogue.content: はっきりさせて、
dialogue.English: settle the matter,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 気持ちをスッキリさせられたら、良いという感じですか？
dialogue.English: and feel a sense of closure, would that be good?

dialogue.content: うーん…裁判しても200万円くらいしか慰謝料が取れない。悔しい…
dialogue.English: Hmm... Even if I go to court, I'll only get about two million yen in damages. It's so frustrating...

dialogue.content: なるほど。そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's how it is.

dialogue.content: 200万円くらいの慰謝料だと悔しいとお感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: So you feel that damages of around 2 million yen would be frustrating.

dialogue.content: 先ほど見返したいとお話しされていましたが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you wanted to make him regret it,

dialogue.content: 本当は1000万円くらいもらってもいいくらいですよね？
dialogue.English: Honestly, I feel like I deserve about 10 million yen, don't I?

dialogue.content: それぐらい悔しい思いをされたんですね。
dialogue.English: That’s how deeply hurt and frustrated you feel.

dialogue.content: 見返したいけど、どーしたら良いのかわからない
dialogue.English: I want to make him regret it, but I don't know how.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: では、見返すことが、あなたが今望んでおられることですね。
dialogue.English: So, making him regret this is what you're hoping for right now.

dialogue.content: お金も時間も帰ってこない
dialogue.English: The money and time won't come back.

dialogue.content: たしかにそうですね。
dialogue.English: That's certainly true.

dialogue.content: くやしい…
dialogue.English: It’s so frustrating...

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: この気持ちを誰かに相談したりはされていますか？
dialogue.English: Have you been talking to anyone about these feelings?

dialogue.content: はい。友達には
dialogue.English: Yes, to my friends.

dialogue.content: なるほど。話してみて気持ちの変化はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Has talking about it changed how you feel?

dialogue.content: 少しはラクになったかな
dialogue.English: I think I feel a little lighter.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今心にいろいろな思いが溜まっていて、
dialogue.English: It seems you have a lot of feelings bottled up inside you right now,

dialogue.content: 吐き出すことで少しすっきりする感じですかね？
dialogue.English: and venting them helps you feel a bit clearer, is that right?

dialogue.content: でも、なんで自分にこんなことが起こるの？って思う
dialogue.English: But I keep wondering, why is something like this happening to me?

dialogue.content: うんうん。ほんとうですよね…そう思うのは自然なことだと思います。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. You're right... It's completely natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 友達は話しは聞いてくれるし、優しいけど、起きたことは変わらないので
dialogue.English: My friends listen and they’re kind, but what happened doesn’t change.

dialogue.content: たしかに。思い出して悔しくもなりますよね。
dialogue.English: That's true. Remembering it must make you feel frustrated all over again.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まだすぐには、思えないかもしれませんが、
dialogue.English: You may not be able to think this way right away, but

dialogue.content: あなたが元気になって
dialogue.English: when you've regained your strength

dialogue.content: 幸せになることが
dialogue.English: and found happiness,

dialogue.content: その彼への一番の見返しになると思うのですが
dialogue.English: I think that would be the best way to make him regret his decision.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません。
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: 今はなかなかすぐには、
dialogue.English: Right now, I know it's quite difficult to immediately

dialogue.content: 気持ちを切り替えられないのが、
dialogue.English: change how you feel,

dialogue.content: 当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: and I think that's completely understandable.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: つらくなることもあると思いますが、
dialogue.English: I'm sure there will be painful times, but,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 友達でもこちらの窓口でも、
dialogue.English: whether it's with your friends or here with us,

dialogue.content: 想いを吐き出してくださいね
dialogue.English: please continue to let your feelings out.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: これにて終了させて頂きます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: This concludes our session. Thank you very much.
